verbetes.glosa_atual: (v.זרז); força, estado de alerta, valor.; (v. próximo w.) pl. זְרָדִים, זְרָרִין brotos, verduras.; pr. n. (b. h.) Zered, nome de um riacho, נחלא דז'.
definicoes_originais: (v. next w.) pl. זְרָדִים, זְרָרִין shoots, greens.
pr. n. (b. h.) Zered, name of a brook, נחלא דז'.
notas_originais: Yoma 47 a (a metaphor in imitation of Prov. XXXI, 29) כל הנשים זֶ' זָרָדוּ וזֶ' אמי עלת' לגג Ar. (read עלה; ed. הנשים זרדו וז' אימא וכ' …; Ms. M. זֶרֶז זָרָזוּ אימא, insert וזֶ'; Ms. M. 2 זריד זרדו וזֶ'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) all women have done valiantly, but the valor of my mother excelled them all (a metaphor of careful maternity).

Tosef. Sabb. IX (X), 16; Sabb. 103 a המְזָרֵד ז' וכ' he who cuts greens, if for human food &c. Ib. XVIII, 2 (126 b) חבילי ז' bundles of greens (young reeds &c., available for fodder); ib. 128 a; Tosef. ib. XIV (XV), 10 זרדן ed. Zuck. (read זרדין, Var. דים …).—Esp. לולבי ז' the young sprouts of the service-tree, the interior of which is eaten as a relish. Shebi. VII, 5. Tosef. Sabb. VIII (IX), 9 לולבין וז' (corr. acc.); Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 13; Tosef. Ukts. III, 9; Ukts. III, 4.
Targ. O. Num. XXI, 12; a. e.—Tosef. Shebi. IV, 11; Y. ib. VI, 36 c; Sifré Deut. 51 דורד; Yalk. Deut. 874 נחלת דור (corr. acc.); v. Hildesh. Beitr. p. 66.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de precedente.) זָ' זֶרֶד (= עשה חיל) fazer corajosamente.; [para fortalecer, acelerar o crescimento; cmp. בְּרָא Af.,] para aparar, cortar os brotos.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of preced.) זָ' זֶרֶד (= עשה חיל) to do valiantly.
[ to strengthen, accelerate growth; cmp. בְּרָא Af.,] to trim, nip shoots off.
notas_originais: Yoma 47 a, v. preced.
Sabb. XII, 2 המקרסם והמְזָרֵד he who cuts off dry twigs, or young shoots. Ib. 103 a, v. preced. Ab. Zar. III, 10 (49 b). Tosef. Sabb. IX (X), 16 וזֵרֵד ed. Zuck. (Var. וזירד).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זרד) cota de malha, armadura (v. P. Sm. 1154, sq. s. vv. זרגא, זרגנא, זרדא).
definicoes_originais: (זרד) coat of mail, armour (v. P. Sm. 1154, sq. s. vv. זרגא, זרגנא, זרדא).
notas_originais: Sabb. 62 a, expl. שריון.
, Tosef. Sabb. XIV (XV), 10, v. זֶרֶד pl.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זרד) arbustos de sorb, ou árvore de serviço, crescendo em pântanos insalubres (v. Löw. Pfl. p. 289) Pes. 111 b דבי ז' שידי (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. nota 400) os espíritos dos arbustos sorb são chamados de shiddé (demônios).
definicoes_originais: (זרד) bushes of sorb, or service-tree, growing in unhealthy marshes (v. Löw. Pfl. p. 289) Pes. 111 b דבי ז' שידי (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) the spirits of the sorb-bushes are named shiddé (demons).
notas_originais: Ib. ז' סמיכא למתא וכ' a sorb-bush near a town has no less than sixty shiddé; [Ms. M. זַרְזְתָא, זִירְזְתָא, זַרְתָּא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes).—Kidd. 73 b ז' … יש בו וכ' a child exposed in a sorb-bush near a town (where it is likely to die) is considered a foundling (אֲסוּפִי). Keth. 79 a אבא ז' וכ' a forest (of timber), a sorb plantation and a fish-pond.
, fem. of זָר q. v.
, v. זרי I, II.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Mela ḥ d’Zarvai, uma fronteira no lado leste do Jordão.
definicoes_originais: Mela ḥ d’Zarvai, a border place on the east side of the Jordan.
notas_originais: Tosef. Shebi. IV, 11 מלח דז' Var. (ed. Zuck. מלי חזרואי); Y. Shebi. VI, 36 c מלח דזרכאיי (read זַרְבַּ' = זַרְוַ', v. Hildesh. Beitr. p. 61, sq.); Sifré Deut. s. 51 עליה זירזא; Yalk. ib. 874 מיליה וירואי. [Hildesh. l. c. a. Neub. Géogr. p. 20 emend מוּלְיָא or (מליתא) מִלְתָא for מלח.]
, v. זֵירוּז

verbetes.glosa_atual: (bh) braço; (com animais) perna dianteira, ombro; força, força.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) arm; (with animals) fore-leg, shoulder; strength, force.
notas_originais: Ber. 17 b ניזונין בז' receive their sustenance from the Lord by dint of their strength (virtue), opp. בצדקה by divine grace. Y. Taan. IV, 69 a top זְרֹועָן של כל ישראל the arm (defence, protection) of all Israel. Sabb. 56 a נטלו בז' they took by force. Lev. R. s. 2 כבא על חבירו בז' like one coming against his neighbor with force (confident of victory).—Ḥull. X, 1 הז' the law concerning the shoulder as the priest’s share (Deut. XVIII, 3). Ib. 98 a ז' בשלה, v. בָּשֵׁל; a. fr.— Pl. זְרֹועֹות, constr. זְרֹועֵי. Sot. 49 b; Tosef. ib. XIV, 3 ז' תורה the supports of the Law.—בעלי ז' violent men. B. Mets. 118 a; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= b. h. זֵרוּעַ; זרע) semeadura; semente.
definicoes_originais: (= b. h. זֵרוּעַ; זרע) sowing; seed.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Lev. XI, 37.— Pl. זֵרוּעִין, זֵי'. Targ. Is. LXI, 11 זֵרוּעָהָא (ed. Lag. זֵירוּעָהּ sing.). [Y. Sabb. IX, 12 a top; Y. Kil. III, beg. 28 c (ref. to Is. l. c.) זֵירוּעֶיהָ מליא zerûëha is spelt plene (with ו); v. יאנא.]
pr. n., נהר ז', v. יָזֵק
Ḥull. 111 a
, v. זְלוּקְפָא
, Cant. R. to II, 9, v. זְרַז I

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de זָר) o status legal do não-sacerdote, as leis relativas aos não-sacerdotes.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of זָר) the legal status of the non-priest, the laws concerning non-priests.
notas_originais: Y. Ter. V, 43 c איסור ז' the prohibition as far as it concerns the T’rumah to be eaten by non-priests. Y. Bicc. II, 65 a היתר ז' inasmuch as they are permitted to non-priests. Y. Orl. II, end, 62 c משום ז' for violating the law forbidding non-priests &c.—Yeb. 68 b, a. e. (ref. to וכל זר, Lev. XXII, 10) ז' אמרתי לך וכ' the Law treats of non-priests, but not of the mourners; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (reduplica. de זר, v. זרר; cmp. אזר) ser forte, vigoroso, rápido, v. fortalecer, tornar ativo e pronto, instigar.; (com ב) advertir, ser severo.; estar alerta, zeloso, consciencioso.
definicoes_originais: (reduplic. of זר, v. זרר; cmp. אזר) to be strong, vigorous, quick, v. זָרַד.
to strengthen, to make active and ready, to instigate.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. זָרוּז, v. זָרִיז.

Pes. 89 a כדי לזַרְזָן … קאמר he said so in order to awaken their emulation in religious acts. Nidd. 31 a; Yoma 47 a זֵירַזְתָּנִי, v. זָרָה I.— Part. pass. מְזֹורָז a) strong, vigorous. Nidd. l. c.; Snh. 70 b; a. e., v. לָבַן II.—b) active, zealous to do good, valiant. Macc. 23 a אין מְזָרְזִין אלא למְזֹורָזִין Ar. (ed. מזורז; some ed. מזרז, corr. acc.) only the strong-minded it is worth encouraging; Yalk. Deut. 937; Sifré Num. 1 למְזֹורָזִים; a. e.
Tanḥ. Korah 6 התחיל מְזָרֵז בהן (Num. R. s. 18 לדבר להם) he began to speak to them earnestly.

Pesik. R. s. 6 (ref. to מהיר, Prov. XXII, 29) נִזְדָּרַזְתָּ במלאכתך thou hast been zealous (conscientious) in thy own occupation. Tanḥ. P’kudé 11; a. fr.—V. זָרִיז.—3) to be armed. Yalk. Num. 785, v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pa. זָרֵיז mesmo;; ser rápido, apressar-se.; para acelerar, fortalecer.; (cmp. זֵיר, אָזַר) amarrar, cingir, braço; para aproveitar, selar.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. זֵיר, אָזַר) to tie around, gird, arm; to harness, saddle.
to strengthen one’s self (so as not to give way to emotion).
to gird one’s self, be armed.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. II Gen. XXIV, 20 (h. text מהר).—Targ. Ps. LXX, 2 זְרֵיז ed. (Ms. זָ'; h. text חוש); a. e.— Part. Pe. זָרִיז, Pa. מְזָרֵז; pl. זְרִיזִין, זַרְזִין, מְזָרְזִין. Targ. Y. I, II Num. IX, 8, opp. מתון; v. also זָרִיז.
Yeb. 102 b (expl. יחליץ, Is. LVIII, 11) זָרוּזֵי גרמי it means quickening the bones. Cant. R. to II, 10 זָרֹוזִי גרמיך (not זרורזי) make thyself ready; Pesik. R. s. 15 זָרְזִי.

Targ. O. Gen. XIV, 14. Targ. Job XXXVIII, 3 זָרֵיז Ms. (ed. זְרֵיז, זְרַז). Targ. O. Ex. XXIX, 9; a. fr.— Part. pass. מְזָרַז, pl. מְזַרְזִין, מְזַרְזַיָּא armed. Ib. XIII, 18. Targ. Is. XV, 4; a. fr.—Yeb. l. c. (ref. to וחלצה, Deut. XXV, 9) ואימא זָרוּזֵי הוא may I not say, it means tying on?
(so as not to give way to emotion). Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 31. Targ. Esth. V, 10.
Targ. Num. XXXII, 17; 20; a. e.—Targ. Prov. XXX, 31, v. זַרְכֵּל.—Sifré Num. s. 157 אין החלצו אלא אִיזְדָּרְזוּ he ḥ al’tsu (Num. XXXI,
means, be armed; Yalk. ib. 785 הִזְדָּרְזוּ (Hebr.).

Kel. XXIII, 2 זֶ' האשקלוני Ar. a. ed. Dehr. (ed. זריז) the Ashkelonian saddle; Sifra M’tsora, Zabim, Par. 2, ch. III; Yalk. Lev. 568 זהו האשתונית (corr. acc.).— Pl. זְרָזִין, constr. (זְרִיזֵי) זַרְזֵי. Erub. 18 b ז' תאנים garments of fig-leaves (v. next w.).

Targ. I Sam. XVIII, 4; a. fr.—Targ. Is. V, 27 זְרִיז (constr., ed. Lag. זרז).— Pl. זְרָזִין, זַרְזִין garments, equipment. Targ. O. Gen. III, 7 (h. text חֲג̇רֹת). Targ. Jud. XIV, 19 זרזיהון ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. זְרָזָהֹון, h. text חליצות').—Targ. Ps. LXXXIII, 15 זַרְזֵי טוריא the crests of mountains (cmp. זִיר; Ms. דָּרֵי, v. דָּרָא I).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (redupl. de זרף, v. זרב) para fluir.
definicoes_originais: (redupl. of זרף, v. זרב) to flow over.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to I, 3 מה השמן … מְזַֹרְזֵף בשאר … מְזַרְזְפִים וכ' (not כשאר) as oil on top of another liquid, when the cup is full, does not flow over with other liquids, so will the words of the Law not flow over (the lips) in connection with words of frivolity.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) esguichos de um recipiente derramados de uma altura.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) squirtings from a vessel poured out from a height.
notas_originais: Yoma 87 a ז' דמיא (Var. זַרְזִיפְתָּא f., pl. זַרְזִיפָתָא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6). [Cmp. b. h. זַרְזִיף].

Y. R. Hash. I, 57 a bot. זה … לנצח זַרְזִירֹו וכ' each is anxious to defeat his antagonist.— Pl. זַרְזִירִין, זַרְזָרִין. Lam. R. to V, 1 אדם … שני זרזרין … כובש וכ' (not כבוש) if a man trains two gladiators in his house, he will restrain the stronger one &c. [Bib. Hebr. זַרְזִיר quick, or armed, v. זרז.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Sir. זרזירא P. Sm. 1156, Ar. zurzur; prob. fr. זור para circular) estorninho, também (coletar.) bando de estorninhos.
definicoes_originais: (Syr. זרזירא P. Sm. 1156, Ar. zurzur; prob. fr. זור to circle) starling, also (collect.) flock of starlings.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 62 a להביא את הז' (Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 3, ch. V הזַרְזִירִים, Ar. רין …) to include the starling (in the genus raven). Ḥull. l. c.; B. Kam. 92 b (prov.) לא לחנם הלך ז' וכ' not without cause does the starling follow the raven &c.; Gen. R. s. 65, beg. Ib. עלה ז' אחד וכ' a flock of starlings came to Palestine.— Pl. זַרְזִירִים, זַרְזִירִין. Ib. s. 75 אין שני ז' וכ' two flocks of starlings cannot sleep on one board (two nations cannot rule at the same time). Tosef. Ḥull. III (IV), 23.
, v. זִרְזֵיף
, v. זַרְזִיר I

verbetes.glosa_atual: cmp. próximo w.) [ espalhar,] brilhar, cintilar, subir (cmp. הָנֵץ).; para fazer brilhar.; (verbo neutro) brilhar.; (denominação de מִזְרָח) para ir para o leste.
definicoes_originais: cmp. next w.) [ to spread,] to shine, sparkle, rise (cmp. הָנֵץ).
notas_originais: Ḥull. 91 b וכי שמש … זָרְחָה did the sun rise for him (Jacob) alone? Y. Snh. VIII, end, 26 c החמה זֹורַחַת וכי … does the sun shine on him (the thief) alone? a. fr.—Tanḥ. Tsav 13, a. fr. צרעת זרחה וכ' leprosy broke out on &c.

Gen. R. s. 22 ה' לו הצרעת the Lord made leprosy glisten on his face. Ib. ה' … חמה he caused the globe of the sun to shine bright for him (a sign of pardon). Lev. R. s. 28, beg. דיין שהקב"ה מַזְרִיחַ וכ' it is reward enough for them that the Lord lets the sun rise &c. Macc. 10 a (ref. to מזרחה, Deut. IV, 41) הַזְרֵחַ שמש וכ' let the sun shine on unwilling manslayers (give them safety). Ib. הִזְרַחְתָּ וכ' thou (Moses) hast &c.
Shebi. IV, 7 משיַזְרִיחוּ (Ms. M. משהִזְ') when the young figs begin to glisten.
Gen. R. s. 61, end (ref. to Gen. XXV, 6) כל מה … להַזְרִיחַ תַּזְרִיחוּ go as far east as you can.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) espalhar, joeirar.; mesmo, também para peneirar, selecione.
notas_originais: Sabb. VII, 2 הזוֹרֶה he who winnows (on the Sabbath).—Ib. 73 b היינו זורה וכ' is not winnowing the same process as sifting &c.?—Ab. Zar. III, 3 שוחק וזורה לרוח he must grind it and cast it to the wind; a. fr.—Euphem. to emit semen. Gen. R. s. 85, v. דּוּשׁ.

Pesik. R. s. 10 שיחקו וזי' וכ' he ground and scattered it &c.—Nidd. 31 a; Yoma 47 a (ref. to ותזרני II Sam. XXII, 40, a. ותאזרני Ps. XVIII, 40) זֵירִיתָנִי וזרזתני thou didst sift me (select the best semen for embryonic formation, cmp. זָרַד) and make me healthy.
Targ. O. Ex. XXXII, 20 (Var. דרא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (seção r. de זוּר) desviar-se, fazer o que é errado.
definicoes_originais: (sec. r. of זוּר) to deviate, to do wrong.
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. LVIII, 4 (ref. to זֹרוּ ib.) מרחם זְרִיתֶם while in the womb you were wrong-doers; Yalk. Ps. 776. Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 5, v. זוּר I.

Lev. R. s. 7, end (ref. to Job VI, 17, applied to the deluge) זְרִיבָתָם לחלוטין וכ' their scalding (destruction by hot water) was final (there is no resurrection for them); Gen. R. s. 28, end; Y. Snh. X, 29 b bot. (cmp. חֲלוּטִין a. צְמִיתוּת).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זרד); =זֶרֶד.; (pelo seu efeito fortalecedor) um caldo ou mingau de grãos quebrados.
definicoes_originais: (from its strengthening effect) a broth or porridge of broken grain.
notas_originais: Ber. 37 a ז' וערסן וכ' Ms. M. (ed. זָרִיז); expl. (in Ms. M. a. Ar., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) ז' ארבע ארבע the dish is called zarid, when the grain is broken into four pieces (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Alica; v. M. Kat. 13 b). Y. Ned. VI, 39 c bot. [Bekh. 44 a, v. זִיוֵּר.]
Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 5 (ref. to זרמתם ib., v. זוּד I) זְרִיָּתָם לשעה היתה their debauchery was only for a while; Yalk. Ps. 841 זְרִיָּיתָם.
, v. זוּרְיֹון

Snh. 70 b בן ז' a healthy child; Num. R. s. 10 זָרוּז.—Tosef. Bekh. VI, 10 אם היה בנו ז' if his son is a bright student; Kidd. 29 b. Pes. 50 b יש ז' ונשכר one is industrious and will be rewarded &c.; Tosef. Yeb. IV, 8, opp. שפל lazy.; a. fr.— Pl. זְרִיזִין, fem. זְרִיזֹות. Pes. 4 a, a. e. ז' מקדימיי למצרת the zealous do their religious duty as early as possible. Sabb. 20 a, a. fr. כהנים ז' הן priests are presumed to be scrupulous.—Pes. 89 a, a. e. נמצאו בנות ז' וכ' the daughters proved to be zealous &c.; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Prov. XXIV, 5 (alguma ed. זדין, corr. acc.). Targ. Y.Lev. XXIV, 12, op. מָתוּן; um. frag.—Ḥull. 107 b דז' porque ele é escrupuloso, contrad. para זָהִיר.— Pl. זְרִיזִין, fem. זְרִיזָן. Targ. Est. III, 15; um. e.—Targ. Y. Ex. eu, 1
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XXIV, 5 (some ed. זדין, corr. acc.). Targ. Y. Lev. XXIV, 12, opp. מָתוּן; a. fr.—Ḥull. 107 b דז' because he is scrupulous, contrad. to זָהִיר.— Pl. זְרִיזִין, fem. זְרִיזָן. Targ. Esth. III, 15; a. e.—Targ. Y. Ex. I, 19 (not … זִין).
Ab. Zar. 20 b, v. זְהִירוּת. Sot. 12 b בז' כעלמה quick like a girl. Lev. R. s. 11, end (ref. to על־מות, Ps. XLVIII, 15) בעלמות בז' with almuth, that is with alertness. Sifra Sh’mini, beg. בז'; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Y.Lev. IX, 8, v. precedido.—Ḥull. 16 a זְרִיזוּתֵיה… קמ"ל o versículo bíblico citado sugere apenas o zelo de Abraão.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Lev. IX, 8, v. preced.—Ḥull. 16 a זְרִיזוּתֵיה … קמ"ל the Bible verse quoted intimates only Abraham’s zeal.
Y. Erub. V, 22 c זְרִיחַת החמה sunrise, East. Gen. R. s. 68 בזְרִיחָתָהּ in its rise. Pes. 2 a כן ז' שמש וכ' Ms. M. (ed. כעין) so will be the sunshine for the righteous &c.; a. fr.

Gen. R. s. 83, end, a. e. בשבילי נִזְרְעָה וכ' the field has been sown for my sake. Shebi. IV, 2 תִּזָרֵעַ may be sown; a. fr.

Peah l. c. אִזְדַּרְעוּן they have been planted.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedido.) semente; sêmen animálico (principalmente שִׁכְבַת ז').
definicoes_originais: preced.) seed; animalic semen (mostly שִׁכְבַת ז').
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 73 נעשו המים ז' וכ' the water in their bellies turned into semen. Y. Kil. I, 27 a bot. נוטל הימנו ז' he may take seed thereof. Shebi. II, 8 שזרעו לז' which he planted for the sake of obtaining seed, opp. לירק for using it as vegetable; a. fr.—Trnsf. issue, descent. Gen. R. s. 23; s. 51 אותו ז' שהוא וכ' that issue which was to come from a foreign place (Moab). Ber. 31 b ז' שמושח וכ' a descendant who will anoint two men; a. fr.— Pl. זְרָעִים. Peah II, 3 הכל מפסיק לז' all of them form a partition with regard to seeds (making each field separately subject to Peah), opp. to trees. Kil. III, 2 כל מין ז' all kinds of seeds (small vegetable), opp. ירקות large beans &c.; a. fr.—Y. Shebi. II, 34 a top ששה זְרָעִין six sowing seasons during a Sabbatical period.—סֶרֶר ז' or ז' Order of Seeds, Z’raim, the first of the six orders of the Mishnah a. Tosefta. Sabb. 31 a. Esth. R. to I, 2.

Targ. O. Gen. I, 11; a. fr. בר ז' that which is fit for propagation, seed-capsule, v. בִּיזְרָא. Targ. Prov. XI, 21; a. fr.—Targ. Ps. XXXVII, 26 Ms. (ed. דרעיה, v. דְּרַע II).—Y. Snh. VII, end, 25 d ז' דכיתן flax-seed.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (bh) [ser arqueado; denominação. חוֹב II;] ao seio, amor.; mesmo, mesmo, amar, valorizar; com לפני ou בפני, de preferência.; (denominação de חָבִיב) tornar-se amado.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) [ to be arched; denom. חוֹב II;] to bosom, love.
same, same, to love, cherish; with לפני or בפני, to prefer.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 27; Tanḥ. Yithro 4 Yithro is named חוֹבָב, שח' את וכ' because he loved the Law; Sifré Num. 78. Sabb. 13 b היו מְחַבְּבִין את הצרות they cherished the memory of past troubles (devoting memorial days to the relief from them). Ib. 51 a, a. e. כמה מחבבין זה את זה how they honor each other. Pes. 100 a בכל יום היית מחבב … בפני thou didst always prefer my opinions to those of R. J., and now thou embracest his opinion in my presence; Y. ib. X, beg. 37 b; Tosef. Ber. V, 2; a. fr.
Gen. R. s. 39 כדי לחַבְּבָהּ בעיניו in order to make him feel the dearness of home; כדי לחַבְּבוֹ וכ' to make him feel how dear was his son to him.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Pa. חַבֵּיב mesmo; amar, honrar.; para fazer amado.; estar amarrados (em afeto).
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. IV, 8 חַבִּבְיָהּ honor her. Targ. O. Deut. XXXIII, 3; a. fr.

Targ. Y. ib.—Sabb. 130 a is it משום חַבּוּבֵי מצוה (Rashi חִיבּוּב) in order to show the high appreciation of the ceremony (of circumcision)?—Ib. אלא לחַבּיּבֵי (Ms. M. לחַבֵּב). Ḥull. 133 a חבובי קא מְחַבֵּב וכ' does he (by taking hastily) prove his anxiety for the divine command, or &c.?
Targ. I Sam. XVIII, 1 (h. text נקשרה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido. wds.) abraçar (em uma luta), lutar.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced. wds.) to embrace (in a fight), to wrestle.
notas_originais: Tosef. Shebu. VI, 2 כל זמן שהיו חוֹבְבִין זה את זה (Var. חוֹכְכִין) as long as they were fighting each other, i.e. if the case comes up immediately after the fight took place; ib. B. Kam. IX, 28 חוככין; Y. Shebu. VII, 37 d bot. חוככין.—V. חֲבִיבָאֵי.
, v. חֲבִיבָאֵי

Koh. K. to V, 14 בא לעולם בח' וכ' man enters the world with love (caressed by his nearest), and leaves with love. Y. Bicc. II, 64 d top לשבעה מיתה של ח' a death after seven days of sickness is a death of (divine) love; (ib. c bot. לשבעים מיתה של ח', read שֵׂיבָה).—Ab. III, 14 ח' יתירה וכ' the greater divine love consists in its being made known to him &c. Ḥull. 33 a, a. e. חִיבַּת הקדש מכשרתן the honor in which sacred objects are held makes them fit for levitical uncleanness (even without contact with liquids, v. כָּשַׁר). Ex. R. s. 2, a. fr. לשון ח' the repetition of a name intimates endearment. Y. Succ. IV, 54 d top לשון ח' (the word שֵׁכָר, Num. XXVIII, 7) expresses something dear; (Bab. ib. 49 b; Num. R. s. 21 שתייה).—Keth. 56 a חיבת חופה וכ' the affection produced by the seclusion in the bridal department is the final act of possession. Gen. R. s. 93; Yalk. ib. 150 [read:] על חיבת העין כך על בעל אכסניא וכ' if this was done for a dear object of sight (our sister), how much more shall we do in defence of the host of the Lord (Benjamin, v. אוּשְׁפִּיזְכָן); a. fr.—Ch. חִיבְּתָא.
B. Kam. 101 b שגיבבן בחיבה Ms. M. (oth. בחבה; ed. בחֵבָא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) which he gathered up for storage; Succ. 40 a לחוּבָה ed. (Ms. Ms. 2 בחיבה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200).
, pr. n. m. בר ח', v. הָבוּ

definicoes_originais: (חָבַט) pressed down, esp. ḥ abut, a legal fiction by which an inclined projection is assumed to be like a horizontal plane.
notas_originais: Erub. 9 a או לבוד … או ח' אמרינן וכ' either we assume the fiction of a junction (v. לָבוּד) or of ḥ abut, but both of them we do not assume. [Rashi reads חֲבוֹט or ch. חביט, as imperative: press it down.]
, v. חוּבְטָא, a. חֲבָטָא.
, v. חֲבַל I, II. [Y. Kidd. IV, 65 d top ח' ימא, v. חֲבֵיל.]
, v. חִיבּ'

Tanḥ. B’shall. 19 (ref. to חבל תחבל, Ex. XXII, 25) … חָבַלְתָּ ח' אחת חֲבוֹלוֹת הרבה if thou seizest a pledge once, thou wilt finally be seized many times (cmp. Ex. R. s. 31, quot. s. v. מַשְׁכּוֹן); Yalk. Ex. 257; Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 1 (corr. acc.). Tosef. Keth. XI, 8 המלוה … על חֲבִילָה וכ' if one gives a loan on a pawn &c.— Pl. חֲבוֹלוֹת, v. supra (Yalk. l. c. חֲבֹלוֹת).
